title: Undeliverable owner refunds are deferred to the owner, never forfeited (Codex M7 static review item 2)
contract: spec section 8.5 (L407) and 8.6 (L421): locked_owner_remaining is transferred to the recorded owner destination; DR-14 owner-attributed return; Codex constraints: no anonymous/free/paid-by-fiat owner funds, no unconditional failing transfer that can block expiry/finalization, immutable destination, exactly-once liability, no custody/admin override, new fee or population cap

where: close.rs settle_books (settlement at terminal promotion) parked an undeliverable owner remainder in ops.unallocated_excess and zeroed the owner liability
close.rs book_return / withdraw_provider_return did the same with the owner share of a provider return

credit_is_deliverable = current > 0 || amount >= minimum called a legacy rent-paying destination deliverable, so on the cluster the transfer inside expire_promotion / apply_promotion / build_candidates would fail and block round recovery
defect.trigger: zero-pot (net-0) closing payout with an owner reserve contribution below the rent-exempt minimum to a fresh destination, or a destination failing validate_destination

runtime_rule_and_local_limit.rule: Agave svm/src/rent_calculator.rs (copied verbatim into LiteSVM 0.7.1 src/utils/rent.rs::transition_allowed, commit 6fbbaf67): an account may end a transaction rent-paying only if it was rent-paying before, kept its data size and was not credited; for a data-less destination with c lamports a credit a > 0 succeeds iff c + a >= minimum(0)
